title: Booking form submission returns silent error on mobile
body: Several parents have reported the lesson booking form fails to submit on mobile browsers (Safari iOS, Chrome Android). The form reloads with no confirmation or error message. Network tab shows a 422 from the booking endpoint before the Stripe payment step.

title: Add online lesson registration and payment flow
body: Parents currently email to enroll. We need a simple online registration form that captures student details, sends the lesson agreement, and collects the first payment via Stripe.

title: Calendar embed shows outdated ensemble rehearsal time
body: The events page Google Calendar embed still shows the old Tuesday 6pm ensemble rehearsal. Jessica confirmed it is now Tuesday and Thursday 7pm. Need to update the calendar source and verify the embed pulls live, not a cached snapshot.

title: Send Stripe payment confirmation email after successful charge
body: After a successful Stripe charge the parent gets no receipt. Add a step that sends a confirmation email via Mailgun (mg.crossroadsconservatory.com) with the booking details once the payment_intent.succeeded webhook fires.

title: Enrollment export fails when student has accented name characters
body: Running export_enrollments.py on the Spring 2026 student list fails with UnicodeEncodeError on students with accented characters (e.g. Jose Ramirez). Encoding fix needed in the CSV writer.
